span.span: Reasoning Content: “0x8AE = 2222. There’s something already listening on port 2222. Let me check if QEMU is running with PID 660 or some other PID.”
Reasoning Content: “The QEMU is running (PID 660) with the host forwarding rule. … Maybe the QEMU process needs to be killed and restarted properly.”
Main work: The agent checks QEMU’s networking options and prepares a new launch with the same port-forwarding rule. Its first attempt uses an unavailable CPU model.
Reasoning Content: “The CPU model ‘qcm6’ doesn’t exist. Let me try with a generic CPU model or omit it.”
Main work: The agent checks that QEMU is still running and port 2222 is listening.
